correctness.rationale: For the reversible generator Lf=m^{-1}(f'/s)' with positive bounded layers and absorbing/reflecting endpoints, exact backward moment equations yield u'=sM and v'=2sK; both moment identities are derived in RESULT.md. Rational integration gives three independently rechecked polynomial branches for F=u²-v. Cubic derivative extrema and monotonicity of the two remaining branches prove one interior zero per layer. The renewal identity gives derivative F/2. The exact rational Laplace-transfer computation reproduces the first two moments at 62 points (including four signed witnesses). Smooth robustness is proved via uniform convergence of explicit integral moment formulas. Neither numerical root approximations nor the finite checks are used to prove uniqueness or smoothness.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2024 source provides bounded-domain heterogeneity analyses and small-rate expansions for a single D(x) with fixed stochastic interpretation, but not this particular independent scale/speed triple-sign construction, its exact three-root count, or smooth persistence. Ray 2020 has fixed linear spatial diffusivity and drift; Julián-Salgado et al. compare two reset points and discontinuous globally optimal rates; Méndez et al. use two absorbing boundaries and nonstandard waiting times. Actual mathematical-record searches for coefficient-of-variation reentrance, resetting bands, three thresholds and scale/speed generators found no theorem that covers this explicit parameterized construction. Generic exact integral formulas are known and correctly credited; novelty is the concrete realizability and sharp spatial count, not the renewal or moment equations.
residual_risks: The full published mathematical literature cannot be exhausted; a general reversible-diffusion theorem or unindexed restart phase diagram might subsume this example.
The 2024 motivating work examines oscillatory diffusivity phase diagrams numerically; this review does not claim multiple spatial switches are globally unprecedented.
No independent scientific proof or priority review has occurred.

value.rationale: The reset-rate derivative sign is a natural first-passage coefficient-of-variation diagnostic determining whether a very small Poisson reset rate helps search. The example supplies two disconnected weak-reset-favorable launch bands for a physically motivated, uniformly elliptic one-dimensional diffusion with potential and mobility contrast, complementing the single-transition examples in the cited literature. Exact count and smooth robustness establish a structural possibility, not a numerical curiosity or a routine source reparameterization. The limited claim does not require unproved global optimum behavior.
